sloka: आस्ये तस्या निमज्जन्तं ददृशुः सिद्धचारणाः ।ग्रस्यमानं यथा चन्द्रं पूर्णं पर्वणि राहुणा ॥५-१-१९३॥
transliteration: āsye tasyā nimajjantaṁ dadṛśuḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ।grasyamānaṁ yathā candraṁ pūrṇaṁ parvaṇi rāhuṇā ॥5-1-193॥

translations.english: The siddhas and charanas who were watching his performance of drowning in her mouth were amazed as though the moon is seized by Rahu on a fullmoon night.
